name: How can I replace my bathroom floor on a limited budget without creating problems later?

mainEntity.name: How can I replace my bathroom floor on a limited budget without creating problems later?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a rental or tight-budget update, prioritize a sound, dry subfloor, a material suited to the room’s water exposure, clean transitions, and a finish that can be maintained easily. Avoid saving money by skipping moisture correction, floor preparation, or proper fixture detailing, because those omissions can cause premature failure. Ask for two scopes—minimum safe replacement and longer-term improvement—so you can compare what each includes. Elite Remodeling & Design can tailor bathroom work to the existing space and the homeowner’s priorities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Control cost by keeping the layout, selecting a practical material, and comparing complete scopes. Do not cut moisture correction, subfloor preparation, toilet detailing, or transitions. Request a budget option and a more durable option with separate line items so you can see what is being postponed, omitted, or upgraded.
